stories.title: Anthropic reveals rapid revenue gains and larger losses in stock market filing
summary: Market debut of AI company behind Claude chatbot will be one of largest in US history, a test of the AI boom’s financial viabilityAnthropic has publicly filed for a stock market listing in what is slated to be one of the largest debuts in history.

The company’s float on the US market will serve as a test of the financial viability of the multitrillion-dollar AI boom.Analysts and investors have valued the San Francisco-based company, founded in 2021, at more than $1.5tn.
The company, which will will list under the symbol ANT, confidentially filed with US financial regulators for an initial public offering in June.

stories.title: ‘Extremely disappointed’: WA government seeks reimbursement from Deloitte over flawed university report
summary: State paid consultancy firm $166,000 for feasibility study on merging the three tertiary institutionsGet our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcastThe Western Australian government has said it is “extremely disappointed” and is seeking an “expedited” cost recovery from Deloitte after errors were discovered in a report about a potential university merger, including AI-hallucinated references and hundreds of millions of dollars in cost discrepancies.The government paid Deloitte $166,000 for a feasibility study on merging the University of Western Australia, Curtin University and Murdoch University.
